children: UFP Industries will acquire the operating assets and real estate of Apache Products (Acme Skid) for approximately $27M, adding about $55M in annual sales and 165 employees. Closing is expected on or around Nov. 16, 2026.
Small, tuck-in deal; signals continued bolt-on M&A strategy.
Implied revenue multiple ~0.5x; accretive potential if margins hold.
Supports immediate capacity expansion in pallets.
Strengthens presence in a key industrial/petrochemical market.
Timing risk remains until close; integration starts post-close.

This is a mid-cycle confirmation of UFPI’s strategy of bolt-on acquisitions to expand UFP Packaging’s PalletOne network. A larger catalyst would be disclosure of expected margin impact, synergies, or updated guidance reflecting the ~$55M sales addition.
